scope: Full current record commit-consumption and file-identity tests
assessment: All operation-history business categories refuse record bytes changed after original commit and preserve substituted bytes
Actual child process rejects FIFO record and metadata without hanging; FIFO remains intact
Write lock replacement after acquisition refuses before record mutation
Object directory swapped to symlink during copy refuses registration and preserves foreign owner file
limitations: No repeated-intent consumption assertion in these files; not assumed
Fault injection covers selected identity boundaries rather than exhaustive operating-system race schedules
